verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with an AI agent (Sona), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Quo publishing its own MCP server and connectors for other agents to call (the server role). Nothing shows Quo itself connecting to or using tools from user-supplied MCP servers, so the server evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
